sets.notesEn: The Pummerin hangs in the north tower of St. Stephen's Cathedral. Rankings vary: since 2016 the c. 25-tonne bell of the People's Salvation Cathedral in Bucharest is heavier than both the Petersglocke and the Pummerin, so the card's 'second-largest' reflects the traditional ranking (Petersglocke first, Pummerin second).
